name: golem-mod
description: golem alerts in Claude Code: a line above the prompt while an incident is open, a toast when one opens or resolves, and /golem for the list.

url.title: golem URL
url.description: Where golem runs. The mod pulls GET /events from it.

keychainService.title: Keychain service
keychainService.description: The macOS keychain item that holds the golem token. The token never leaves memory.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval
pollSeconds.description: Seconds between pulls. 30 by default; 10 at the least.
